name: TED-LIUM Release 3
description: TED-LIUM Release 3 is an automatic speech recognition corpus comprising 452 hours of audio extracted from 2,351 TED talks. It includes high-quality aligned audio recordings and corresponding transcripts, along with an extensive language modeling text corpus of 2.6 million words.
